messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: connecting pairs
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to connect the dots (literally), for each "id" and "year", between actl and pred.

So I plot the points by yr, with colour mapped to variable, and dodged. And then I want to connect the dodged points to each other (those belonging to the same id).

I would've thought grouping by "id" would've done the job, but it doesn't.

Thanks as always for the help.  

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

actl<-runif(100)
pred<-actl + rnorm(100)
yr<-c(rep(1,50),rep(2,25),rep(3,25))
id <- 1:100
tst <- data.frame(actl,pred,yr,id)
tst.melt<-melt(tst,id.var=c("yr","id"))

ggplot(tst.melt,aes(yr,value,colour=variable))+
geom_point(position=position_dodge(1))+
geom_line(aes(group=id))

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: connecting pairs
parts:
Hi Adam:

You get the vertical lines because geom_line() doesn't adjust for the
dodged points within year. Another approach is to offset the actual
and predicted responses in advance:

# Generate the offset in the data frame
tst.melt$offset <- ifelse(tst.melt$variable == "actl", -0.25, 0.25)

ggplot(tst.melt,aes(yr + offset, value, colour=variable))+
geom_point() +
geom_line(aes(group=id)) +
labs(x = "year")

Dennis

ggplot(tst.melt,aes(yr + offset, value, colour=variable))+

   geom_line(aes(group=id)) +

Dennis
